description:
### 1. Overall Layout and Style

The figure is a wide-aspect-ratio diagram designed for full-width placement, set against a pristine white background for maximum clarity. It projects a clean, sophisticated, and modern academic aesthetic. The composition is organized into three distinct, equal-width panels arranged horizontally, separated by generous whitespace to ensure each method is clearly delineated. Each panel illustrates a verification formulation through a clear, top-to-bottom "Input → Model → Output" flow, using a distinct, harmonious pastel color to visually code each approach.

**General Styling:**
*   **Background:** A pure, clean white canvas.
*   **Fonts:** A classic serif font is used for primary labels to convey authority, while a clean sans-serif font is used for smaller annotations and subtitles for readability.
*   **Shapes & Effects:** All primary components are represented as rectangles with softly rounded corners. A very subtle, soft drop shadow is applied to all boxes, giving them a slight lift and creating a sense of depth and layering.
*   **Color Palette:** The palette is professional and muted. A calm slate blue distinguishes the first panel, a warm, desaturated terracotta orange the second, and a deep, muted sage green the third.
*   **Arrows:** Data flow is indicated by thin, medium-gray arrows with small, elegant arrowheads, ensuring connections are clear but not visually overpowering.

---

### 2. Panel (a): CLS — Classification

This panel, labeled **(a)** in the top-left corner, illustrates the classification-based approach. It is visually unified by a professional slate blue color scheme.

*   **Header:** At the very top, a header bar with a solid slate blue fill is labeled "**CLS — Classification**". The bar features softly rounded top corners.
*   **Input:**
    *   A rounded rectangle with a very light, neutral gray fill and a delicate, slightly darker gray border is positioned at the top of the flow.
    *   It is labeled "**Code + Test**" in a bold serif font.
    *   Below the title, a smaller, gray sans-serif subtitle reads "per-test input".
*   **Model:**
    *   A downward-pointing gray arrow connects the Input to the Model container.
    *   The Model is represented by a white rounded rectangle with a delicate slate blue border.
    *   It is centered and contains the text "**LoRA Model**", accompanied by a minimalist brain or gear icon.
*   **Output:**
    *   Another downward gray arrow connects the Model to the Output container.
    *   The Output is a compact, rounded rectangle with a solid slate blue fill and crisp white text.
    *   It contains the bolded text "**PASS / FAIL**".
    *   A smaller line of text below in a lighter, softer shade of slate blue reads "1 token".
*   **Annotations:**
    *   Below the entire flow, an italicized gray sans-serif annotation reads "Per-test granularity".
    *   To the side of the Output box, a small, vibrant green circular badge with a white checkmark (✓) is placed, labeled "diagnostic".

---

### 3. Panel (b): CWM — Code World Model

The central panel, labeled **(b)**, describes the Code World Model approach and uses a warm terracotta orange color scheme. Its output stage is visually more complex, signifying a multi-step process.

*   **Header:** A terracotta orange header bar, styled like the first panel, is labeled "**CWM — Code World Model**".
*   **Input:**
    *   The Input container is styled identically to panel (a) (light neutral gray fill, rounded rectangle).
    *   It is labeled "**Code + Test**" with the subtitle "per-test input".
*   **Model:**
    *   A downward arrow leads to the Model container.
    *   This is a white rounded rectangle with a delicate terracotta orange border, containing the label "**LoRA Model**". The vertical position of this box is precisely aligned with the model boxes in the other panels for visual consistency.
*   **Output (Two-Stage):**
    *   A downward arrow points to a taller, more complex output section.
    *   **Stage 1 (Generation):** The first part is a rounded rectangle with a solid terracotta orange fill and white text, labeled "**Execution Output**" in bold. Below this, in a lighter shade of terracotta, it reads "O(L) tokens".
    *   **Stage 2 (Comparison):** A short arrow points horizontally to the right, connecting the generation box to a second box. This comparison box has a pale terracotta background and dark text. It contains the symbol "**≟ Expected**" with a small gray subtitle below it reading "exact match".
*   **Annotations:**
    *   The annotation "Per-test granularity" is placed below the flow in gray italics.
    *   Near the Output, there is a small, cautionary red circular badge with a white 'X' (✗), labeled "format collapse at repo level".

---

### 4. Panel (c): TRAJ — Trajectory

The rightmost panel, labeled **(c)**, represents the trajectory-level formulation using a deep, muted sage green color scheme. Its input container is visually larger to signify a greater volume of data.

*   **Header:** A sage green header bar is labeled "**TRAJ — Trajectory**".
*   **Input:**
    *   The Input container is noticeably taller and wider than in the other two panels, emphasizing its larger data scope. It is styled with a light neutral gray fill and softly rounded corners.
    *   It is labeled "**Full Patch + All Tests**" in bold. A small, clean icon representing a stack of documents is included to visually reinforce the "all tests" concept.
    *   The gray subtitle reads "patch-level input".
*   **Model:**
    *   A downward arrow connects to the Model container.
    *   This is a white rounded rectangle with a delicate sage green border, labeled "**LoRA Model**" and vertically aligned with the other model boxes.
*   **Output:**
    *   A final downward arrow points to the Output container.
    *   This is a compact, solid sage green rounded rectangle with white text, visually similar in size to the output in panel (a) to highlight its one-token nature.
    *   It is labeled "**RESOLVED / UNRESOLVED**" in bold.
    *   Below, a smaller line of text in a lighter shade of sage green reads "1 token".
*   **Annotations:**
    *   An italicized gray annotation below the flow reads "Patch-level granularity".
